news.ctx: 2026 年 8 月 23 日豪雨猛炸南台灣，各地道路積淹水、路樹傾倒，高雄、屏東合計撤離超過 2,000 人。
news.ctxEn: On 23 August 2026, torrential rain hit southern Taiwan, flooding roads and toppling trees; more than 2,000 people were evacuated across Kaohsiung and Pingtung.
news.lesson: 撤離要在雨還沒最大時就決定，太早被說擾民，太晚就來不及。
news.lessonEn: Evacuation must be called before the worst rain: too early looks disruptive, too late is deadly.

options.label: 開設收容所、派車接送撤離
options.note: 保住人命最優先，但很吃人力。

options.en: Pay relief and speed up cleanup
options.label: 發放災後救助金、加速清理
options.note: 讓生活快點恢復，花費不小。
options.noteEn: Gets life back faster, at real cost.

options.en: Issue alerts and ask residents to self-evacuate
options.label: 只發警報、請居民自主撤離
options.note: 省資源，但行動不便的長輩可能來不及。
options.noteEn: Saves resources, but frail elders may not make it.

news.title: 豪雨撤離逾 2,000 人

news.ctx: 交通部 9 月公布，2026 年 1 到 7 月全國 65 歲以上交通死亡 697 人，比去年同期增加 5%；台中增加 14 人，增幅全國第二。機車在路口左轉被對向車撞是常見情形。
news.ctxEn: Ministry data released in September show 697 people aged 65+ died on Taiwan’s roads from January to July 2026, up 5%. Taichung’s rise of 14 was the second largest; scooters hit while turning left at intersections are a common case.
news.lesson: 很多長輩靠機車維持生活，要讓他們少騎車，就得先給他們別的選擇。
news.lessonEn: Many elders rely on scooters; to get them off, you first have to offer another option.

options.label: 路口改兩段式左轉、加左轉燈
options.note: 減少最常見的事故，等燈時間變長。
options.noteEn: Cuts the most common crash; waits get longer.

options.label: 社區小巴接送長輩
options.note: 長輩不用自己騎車，但每年都要營運費。
options.noteEn: Elders need not ride, but it costs every year.

options.en: Dusk safety campaign for autumn and winter
options.label: 秋冬黃昏安全宣導
options.note: 天黑得早、溫差大，提醒有用但有限。
options.noteEn: Early dusk and cold snaps raise risk; reminders help a little.

news.title: 長者交通死亡又增加

news.ctx: 2026 年 7 月颱風巴威逼近，台南市府派人逐段巡檢下水道、加速清疏，希望在風雨來之前把排水路清通。
news.ctxEn: As Typhoon Bavi approached in July 2026, Tainan sent crews to inspect sewers section by section and speed up clearing before the storm.
news.lesson: 防颱要在颱風來之前做完，平常看不見的清疏，關鍵時刻才顯出價值。
news.lessonEn: Typhoon prep must be done before it arrives; routine drain work only shows its value in a crisis.

options.label: 全員出動清疏低窪區
options.note: 效果最好，但其他事情得暫停。
options.noteEn: Most effective, but other work has to wait.

options.label: 預先布署移動式抽水機
options.note: 淹了能快點退，但擋不住淹水。
options.noteEn: Water recedes faster, but it still floods.

options.en: Hand out sandbags and ask residents to prepare
options.label: 發放沙包、請居民自主防範
options.note: 便宜，但長輩搬不動沙包。
options.noteEn: Cheap, but elders cannot lift sandbags.

news.title: 颱風逼近，下水道趕清疏
